about:
Incipio Devices is an orthopedic device company based in Huntington, Indiana, with an additional office in St-Blaise, Switzerland. The company was founded by a group of industry experts who aimed to provide solution-driven approaches to commercial products, contract manufacturing, and development. No founding year or ownership details are publicly disclosed.

The company offers a full spectrum of services from prototyping and design for manufacturability through verification and validation (V&V) to production manufacturing. Capabilities include 3D modeling, component and assembly drawings, manufacturing prints and models, and project partnership directly with surgeons, entrepreneurs, and small to large orthopedic companies. They also maintain cross-compatibility with industry-standard reamers such as crossbars and Bridgeback systems.

Incipio serves the orthopedic and broader medical device industries. Its customer base includes surgeons seeking custom solutions, entrepreneurs launching new devices, and established orthopedic companies requiring contract manufacturing or development support. The firm emphasizes end-to-end collaboration from concept through manufacturing and release.

According to the company, its differentiation lies in a solution-driven mindset that integrates commercial product development with contract manufacturing. Its quality policy commits to consistently meeting or exceeding customer, statutory, and regulatory requirements while pursuing ever-improving quality through programs that enable each employee to do the job right the first time.
